description: Every QuickBooks Online Accounting entity, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity search, and AR/AP aging no SDK or read-only MCP ships.
auth_description:
OAuth 2.0 bearer access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Obtain one
from the Intuit OAuth 2.0 Playground or mint it from a refresh token. Also set the
company scope via QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID (+ QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT=production|sandbox)
or the full QUICKBOOKS_BASE_URL. Required scope: com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting.

novel_features.name: AR aging buckets
novel_features.description: See exactly who owes you and how overdue, bucketed 0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 90+ and rolled up by customer.

novel_features.name: AP aging buckets
novel_features.description: The payables mirror of AR aging: open bills bucketed by age and rolled up by vendor, so you know what's due and when.

novel_features.name: Cash & balance snapshot
novel_features.description: One view of bank/AR/AP account balances plus total customer receivables and total vendor payables.

novel_features.name: Stale-invoice collection list
novel_features.description: Overdue invoices older than N days, ranked by age times balance so the biggest, oldest debts surface first.

novel_features.name: Unapplied payments leak
novel_features.description: Payments with money received but not applied to any invoice — a reconciliation leak that quietly distorts AR.

novel_features.name: Top customers by balance
novel_features.description: Rank customers by outstanding balance (or lifetime invoiced) to see concentration and collection focus.

novel_features.name: Duplicate name-list detection
novel_features.description: Fuzzy-match customers (or vendors) by display name and email to catch duplicate records before they fragment AR/AP.

novel_features.name: Vendor spend over a window
novel_features.description: Total billed per vendor over a date window, ranked — see where the money goes.

novel_features.name: Aging delta vs last sync
novel_features.description: See what changed in receivables and payables since the previous sync — who slipped an aging bucket and whose balance grew.

novel_features.name: Customer profitability / net position
novel_features.description: Per-customer net position: total invoiced minus payments received, open balance, and average days-to-pay, ranked across the whole book.

novel_features.name: Days Sales Outstanding
novel_features.description: Rolling DSO plus per-customer average days-to-pay — the headline collections-efficiency KPI.

novel_features.name: Cash-flow due-date forecast
novel_features.description: Projected net cash movement by week: expected invoice inflows minus bill outflows bucketed by due date over the next N weeks.

novel_features.name: Reconcile / close health check
novel_features.description: One month-end hygiene sweep: unapplied payments, duplicate names, unbalanced journal entries, and inactive records on open transactions in a single findings list.

novel_features.name: Unbalanced journal-entry check
novel_features.description: Flag journal entries whose debit and credit lines don't net to zero or that touch suspense accounts.
